name: skeleton
summary: Preserves a known layout with a decorative, non-announcing loading placeholder.

agent.useWhen: Loading data should preserve the shape of a known final interface layout.
agent.avoidWhen: The final layout is unknown or measurable task progress should be communicated.

invariants: Shape is required; size defaults to medium, width to full, and animated to true. Unknown fields and enum values are rejected.
Every placeholder is aria-hidden and has no role, live region, busy state, content, script, or runtime style input; the parent application owns aria-busy and its concise loading announcement.
Width presets are orthogonal to shape and size for text and rectangles; circles keep their size-defined square geometry, so width presets do not change circle dimensions.
The width presets use intrinsic percentages of the containing block, capped at the available inline size; circles preserve a 1:1 aspect ratio and clamp to narrow containers.
Animation is decorative and runs without JavaScript by default, can be disabled explicitly, and is disabled for reduced-motion users.
The adapter fragment contains exactly one [[skeleton]] slot; no arbitrary CSS dimensions or runtime HTML attributes are accepted.
